Aisha K.: morning — quick async standup for dealflow + security asks
Aisha K.: HelioPay moving to legal review; they want a private deployment option and explicit KMS/HSM notes. I sent them the docs link and asked for network topology.
Rafael M.: timeline from HelioPay? we promised an answer by EOW last week, they asked for an architecture diagram. can we share an internal arch diagram or a sanitized one?
Aisha K.: target is EOD Thursday. Kendall, can you produce a one-page sanitized diagram (no internal IPs) and call out SSO + KMS?
Kendall S.: yep, I can do that today. will paste diagram as PNG in convo. Also flag: HelioPay asked about SOC2 + data residency for EU customers — do we have a short blurb?
Priya (sec): HelioPay is medium risk due to PHI adjacency. We need the security questionnaire answers + confirmation on encryption at rest with customer-managed keys for Private. I can draft the questionnaire responses; need the KMS flow from eng.
Kendall S.: for KMS flow, see snippet below (sanitized):
```
Customer KMS -> External Keywrap -> Redwood Vault -> Node-level DEK encryption
```
Kendall S.: Rafael — do you want me to include a sentence about EU data residency regions (we support eu-west-1 / eu-central-1)?
Rafael M.: yes please. also add: SLA implications if they request dedicated capacity in EU.
Aisha K.: noted. next deal: CampusLabs — pilot kickoff scheduled Tue. They want a short checklist for integration (SSO, data retention, rate limits). I added a Confluence page and shared the link with their PM.
Priya (sec): for CampusLabs, minimal ask: confirm SCIM/SSO provider and retention defaults. If they plan to ingest student records, escalate to compliance.
Kendall S.: pinging eng-oncall for a quick review of the onboarding flow — /cc @eng-oncall in the confluence comments.
sec-bot: Automated: Security questionnaire 0033 assigned to Priya (sec), due 2026-03-19.
Rafael M.: BrightMap update: legal asked for a PII dataflow. I have a draft, need security eyes before sending. Priya, can you review later today?
Priya (sec): yes, I can take BrightMap after I finish HelioPay Qs. ETA 6pm PT.
Aisha K.: blockers: 1) sanitized arch diagram for HelioPay (Kendall) 2) KMS flow confirmation (eng) 3) security questionnaire answers (Priya) — tagging here so we can close by Thu EOD.
Rafael M.: I'll follow up with HelioPay PM to nudge legal.
Kendall S.: starting diagram now. will post draft by 1pm PT.
Aisha K.: thanks everyone — post quick updates here when complete. :rocket:
